notes_for_editor: Only two register listings support this record: no NHLR or FFLOS number, no build year, no staffing and no fire history. Searches on Maine Memory, the Maine State Archives fire-tower maps and the web returned nothing for Simmons Hill. The story is well under the 120-word floor because nothing else could be sourced; it was not padded. Register coordinates are 44.9952, -68.49532. Worth checking Maine Forest Service annual reports or a Bangor-area newspaper before the story is extended.
